description: Official PyTorch-native TPU backend for vLLM; separate out-of-tree plugin/package from vllm-tpu (JAX-native).

assertions.assertion: vLLM-TorchTPU official repository provides official guidance on Official PyTorch-native TPU backend for vLLM; separate out-of-tree plugin/package from vllm-tpu (JAX-native).
TorchTPU is the native PyTorch runtime replacing the deprecated PyTorch/XLA backend for TPU workloads.
vLLM-TorchTPU is the out-of-tree PyTorch-native serving backend for vLLM on TPUs, distinct from the JAX-native vllm-tpu backend.
